newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oseberg output back to normal after brief outage.
newsitem.headline: Oseberg output back to normal after brief outage.

text.p: Oil production at the Oseberg A platform was back to normal following a brief stoppage due to a small fire in an electricity generator early on Friday, operator Norsk Hydro ASA said.
The blaze on the Oseberg A platform of the 360,000 barrel per day Oseberg field centre was extinguished after 10 minutes following a fire alarm at around 0800 GMT, a Hydro spokesman said.
There was no need to evacuate any of the 205 personnel on board the platform.
"There was no damage or complications as a result of the fire. The production was resumed almost immediately and we are now back to normal," the spokesman said.
